info.description: The Coupon Management API enables businesses to efficiently update or replace existing coupons using their unique identifiers. This functionality is essential for maintaining accurate promotional campaigns and ensuring customer satisfaction. Typical users include marketing and operations teams who manage coupon distributions and promotional offers. The API facilitates seamless adjustments and supports dynamic marketing strategies through simple integrations.

put.summary: Update a specific coupon by its ID.
put.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a coupon using its unique identifier. Ensure that you provide the required data in the request body to successfully modify the coupon information.

requestBody.description: The request body for updating an existing coupon with ID 016. This should contain the necessary details about the coupon that need to be updated such as discount amount, expiration date, and any applicable terms and conditions.

200.description: Request completed successfully, coupon details updated.
